panels.title: No Sleep Data Yet
panels.description: Sleep data will appear here once synced from Withings or another provider. Connect a sleep-tracking device to populate this dashboard.

options.content:
### Sleep data will populate automatically once synced from Withings or another provider.
Connect a sleep-tracking wearable to see sleep duration, stages, and efficiency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT er.start_datetime AS time, sd.sleep_total_duration_minutes AS "Sleep Duration"
FROM event_record er
JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id
JOIN sleep_details sd ON sd.record_id = er.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND er.category = 'sleep'
  AND (sd.is_nap IS NULL OR sd.is_nap = false)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
ORDER BY er.start_datetime

panels.title: Sleep Efficiency
panels.description: Percentage of time in bed actually spent sleeping. Higher is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT er.start_datetime AS time, sd.sleep_efficiency_score AS "Efficiency"

JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id

panels.title: Sleep vs Next-Day Weight Change
panels.description: Does better sleep correlate with weight trends? Shows sleep duration alongside weight delta.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT er.start_datetime AS time,
  sd.sleep_total_duration_minutes / 60.0 AS "Sleep Hours"
FROM event_record er
JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id
JOIN sleep_details sd ON sd.record_id = er.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND er.category = 'sleep'
  AND (sd.is_nap IS NULL OR sd.is_nap = false)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
ORDER BY er.start_datetime

WITH daily_weight AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', dps.recorded_at) AS day, dps.value AS weight,
    dps.value - LAG(dps.value) OVER (ORDER BY dps.recorded_at) AS delta
  FROM data_point_series dps
  JOIN data_source ds ON dps.data_source_id = ds.id
  WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
    AND dps.series_type_definition_id = 41
    AND $__timeFilter(dps.recorded_at)
)
SELECT day AS time, delta AS "Weight Change"
FROM daily_weight
WHERE delta IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY day

SELECT
  er.start_datetime AS "night",
  sd.sleep_total_duration_minutes AS "total_min",
  sd.sleep_deep_minutes AS "deep",
  sd.sleep_rem_minutes AS "rem",
  sd.sleep_light_minutes AS "light",
  sd.sleep_awake_minutes AS "awake",
  sd.sleep_efficiency_score AS "efficiency",
  CASE WHEN sd.is_nap THEN 'Nap' ELSE 'Night' END AS "type"
FROM event_record er
JOIN data_source ds ON er.data_source_id = ds.id
JOIN event_record_detail erd ON erd.record_id = er.id
JOIN sleep_details sd ON sd.record_id = er.id
WHERE ds.user_id = '8737f98d-647a-4e0e-9f6e-c9df5da82d59'
  AND er.category = 'sleep'
  AND $__timeFilter(er.start_datetime)
ORDER BY er.start_datetime DESC
